name: aceternity-ui-meteors
blurb: Meteors stream diagonally downward across the screen.
description: Renders animated meteor streaks falling from top to bottom at random intervals. Pure CSS animation with random stagger delays and durations.
use_when: Sci-fi or space-themed hero sections, dramatic backgrounds, or cosmic visualizations.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (animation cannot be disabled); busy layouts (visual noise).
a11y: Background animation only; no interactive elements. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
